key.name: led-list
key.description: Sysfs LED names to manage. Empty means autodetect all tpacpi::*, platform::* and input* LEDs.

key.name: led-list-custom
key.description: Internal flag set on the first manual enable/disable change. When false, an empty led-list means autodetect all; when true, empty means manage none.

key.name: led-names
key.description: Map of sysfs LED name to user-visible display name. LEDs without an entry show their sysfs name.

key.name: led-quick
key.description: Sysfs LED names shown in quick settings. Empty means show all enabled LEDs.

key.name: led-quick-custom
key.description: Internal flag set on the first manual quick-settings visibility change. When false, an empty led-quick means show all enabled LEDs; when true, empty means show none.

key.name: led-binding
key.description: Map of sysfs LED name to activity binding: "disk:blink", "disk:pulse", "net:blink" or "net:pulse". Absent means manual control.

key.name: morse-text
key.description: Last-used Morse message (ITU letters A-Z and digits 0-9); sent by the Quick Settings Morse button.

key.name: morse-led
key.description: Sysfs LED name the Morse sender blinks. Empty falls back to the currently selected quick-settings LED.

key.name: morse-unit
key.description: Duration of one Morse time unit in milliseconds. Dot = 1 unit, dash = 3 units, gaps 1/3/7 units.
